correctness.rationale: Each monomial of the displayed smooth quartic family is weight-invariant modulo 27 under diag(1,24,18,9,0). For 26 nonidentity group elements the projective eigenspace partitions are exactly 18 four-vertex fixed sets, six (plane curve C plus e1/e2), and two (quartic K3 surface S plus e1). At e1,e2,e3,e4 the tangent weights computed by deleting one coordinate using the nonzero partial derivative are respectively (17,8,26), (4,21,3), (10,6,18), (19,15,9). At e2..e4 quotienting an order-three pseudoreflection gives order-nine weights (4,7,1), (1,2,6), (1,5,3); the latter two represent equivalent germs. Independent residue-age calculation confirmed noncanonical min Reid-Tai age 1/3 at e1 and age one at the other three. The generic curve transverse action reduces to 1/3(1,2), giving A2; C/G is elliptic by Riemann-Hurwitz and has invariant function field z^2=(1+bu+au^2)^2-4u^3. The ramification identity q^*(-K_Y)=3H gives volume 3^3*4/27=4; Burnside fixed-locus Euler gives (-56+18*4+6*(-4+2)+2*(24+1))/27=2. Smoothness of at least one member follows exact affine Groebner plus infinity test in inspected certificate. All-member statement is explicitly conditional on X smooth; quotient index 9 from local stabilizers. No assertion of canonical quotient or a smooth resolution.
